entities.summary: Prince Vasily Vasilyevich Golitsyn was a Russian aristocrat and statesman of the 17th century. He belonged to the Golitsyn as well as Romodanovsky Muscovite noble families. His main political opponent was his cousin Prince Boris Alexeyevich Golitsyn.
